```plato

// A key with explicit incoming and outgoing tangents for Bezier and Hermite
// interpolation. Tangents are value slopes per second; the weights give each
// handle's reach as a fraction of the segment span (classic default one third).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cubic_Hermite_spline)
type TangentKeyframe<T>
{
    Time: Duration;
    Value: T;
    InTangent: T;
    OutTangent: T;
    InWeight: Proportion;
    OutWeight: Proportion;
}
```
